name: idea89/woocommerce-assistant
description: IDEA89 AI shopping assistant for WooCommerce

scripts.lint:php74: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app:ro -w /app php:7.4-cli sh -c 'find . -path ./vendor -prune -o -name "*.php" -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 -P4 php -l'

scripts-descriptions.lint:php74: Parses every tracked PHP file under a real PHP 7.4 CLI (via Docker) to catch PHP 8-only syntax that phpcompatibility 9.3.5 cannot detect.
